_inventory_conventions.generated: Draft produced by scripts/generate_inventory.py. NOT ready to commit. Work through the checklist below - the machine filled what it can measure; everything here is what it cannot know.

1_WRITE.components: Jira Component name(s) this page serves, e.g. ['Products']. Left EMPTY by the crawler. Without it Agent 2 receives the whole inventory for every story instead of just this page.
1_WRITE.elements_notes: Per-key traps: what breaks, what to do instead. The highest-value field in the file, and the one a crawler can never produce.
1_WRITE.key_methods: The methods this page object should expose, as business verbs - login_as(email, password), not type_then_click(). OPTIONAL once the page object exists: Agent 2 reads its real signatures from the repo. Write it for a page not yet built.
1_WRITE.errors: Exact validation message text, if the page has any.
1_WRITE.url + url_sample: A page crawled at one RECORD's address arrives pinned to it, e.g. '/records/1'. Rewrite the url as a template - '/records/{record_id}' - and add url_sample: '/records/1' so the browser tools still have a concrete address to visit. Rename the page too: 'records_1' should become 'record_detail'.
1_WRITE.always: Set true on shared chrome (the navigation bar) and move its elements there. A crawler cannot tell chrome from page content, so every page arrives carrying its own copy of the nav - five copies to keep in step, and five page objects each with their own click_cart().

2_VERIFY_AND_CORRECT_never_delete.elements: Trim to what tests actually need. A content-heavy page can yield 150+ keys where a story uses ten, and every one costs prompt tokens on every generated file.
2_VERIFY_AND_CORRECT_never_delete.multi_match: Keys matching SEVERAL elements. ENFORCED at generation time - it is what rejects code that clicks a 68-match family. Measured at crawl time; confirm it, never remove it.
2_VERIFY_AND_CORRECT_never_delete.conditional: Elements that exist only after an interaction. AUTO-DETECTED for anything hidden at crawl time, but a modal absent from the DOM entirely cannot be detected - add those by hand.
2_VERIFY_AND_CORRECT_never_delete.multi_match_note / conditional_note: Permanent guidance sent to the LLM, not review artefacts. Keep them.

3_FIX_THEN_DELETE_THE_BLOCK._selectors_to_improve: Real elements located by a STRUCTURAL PATH. They resolve today and break when anything above them re-renders. Replace each with an id, name, href or a data-test added to the app, remove the key from the list, then delete the block when it is empty.
3_FIX_THEN_DELETE_THE_BLOCK._families_without_a_shared_handle: A repeated widget whose instances had NO selector in common, so only one was kept. Find the shared class in DevTools (usually there is one), set it as the family selector and add the key to multi_match - or avoid the family entirely by acting on one record's own page, where the control is unique.
3_FIX_THEN_DELETE_THE_BLOCK._third_party_elements: Ad and widget embeds. Delete the elements AND the block; their text rotates per impression.
3_FIX_THEN_DELETE_THE_BLOCK._unresolved_selectors: Measured ZERO against the live page. The element exists - the locator does not work. Fix each.

4_DELETE_OUTRIGHT: any remaining key beginning with '_' (review notes, never inventory)
review_checklist.5_THEN_MEASURE: python -m scripts.verify_locators --inventory <file> --only-problems   (add --no-login for sign-in and sign-up pages: with a session they redirect and nothing can be measured)

_inventory_conventions.selectors: Every selector maps to a first-class Playwright locator, in priority order: [data-test='x'] / #id / [name='x'] (css), role=combobox[name='Country'] (getByRole), label=Email (getByLabel), placeholder=... , alt=Search (getByAltText), title=Close (getByTitle), text=Submit (getByText). XPath is never emitted. An iframe-chained selector uses ' >>> ', e.g. iframe#pay >>> [data-test='card']. label=/alt=/title= need page.get_by_label/get_by_alt_text/get_by_title (they are NOT page.locator() engine syntax); role= and text= work with page.locator() directly.
_inventory_conventions._unstable_selectors: If present on a page, these elements had no durable handle (only a fragile css fallback). Add a data-test in the app or replace with a role/label/text locator before relying on them.
_inventory_conventions._ambiguous_selectors: If present, these selectors were produced for MORE THAN ONE element on the page. Playwright locators are strict by default, so each one raises 'strict mode violation: locator resolved to N elements' at runtime. Give each element a distinct handle (add a data-test) or disambiguate with .nth()/.filter() in the page object.
